judgment: The town may move, but the well does not.
Nothing is lost, nothing gained — they come and go, and the well wells on.
Almost at the water, but the rope not yet down —
image: Water up in the trees: Well.
So the noble one comforts the people,
urging them to help each other.
lines: The well is mud, and no one drinks from it.
It is an old well: not even birds come.
At the well's low pool he shoots little fish,
while his jar is cracked and leaking.
The well is cleaned, but no one drinks from it —
if the king is bright, all receive its blessing.
a cold spring, and people drink from it.
The well is drawn from: do not cover it.

notes.name_en: 井 the well itself; the single thing named (cf. Heaven, Pit).
notes.judgment: 繘 the well-rope not yet down (未繘井); 瓶 the small drawing-jug, smashed at the mouth.
